arm.policy_definition: Use the complete fixed ungated-parent trajectory if the natural-observation risk exceeds the frozen exploration-high quantile; otherwise use the exact frozen Base. No PDMS/GT at runtime.

score_selection: strict unrounded real PDMS; no external failure gate; no extra safety filter

endpoints.R1: Best actual entry separately per seed, mean over five
endpoints.R2: One actual entry maximizing five-seed mean, same entry on all five
endpoints.R3: Choose entry on S0-S2 only; fixed entry evaluated on S3-S4, negative gains retained

tie_break: Base first; then smaller actual relative edit; then stable candidate ID
teacher_snapshot: Freeze first42 once complete; later live-best updates do not freeze snapshots
test_use: Only diagnostic evaluation of frozen entries; never student supervision or candidate expansion
